visit_note.text:
Date of visit: 2026-03-22
Patient: 78-year-old woman, established patient.
Chief complaint: locked left knee
History: left knee locked in flexion since a twisting injury; unable to straighten it or bear weight.
Examination: knee held at 30 degrees, block to extension.
Assessment: displaced medial meniscal tear with a locked knee.
Procedure: arthroscopic partial medial meniscectomy, left knee.
The procedure was carried out the same day because the knee could not be left locked.
Signed: treating clinician. 2026-03-22.

supporting_documents.text:
Billing note, 2026-04-26
Claim submitted 2026-03-28.
Authorization request for the urgent service sent 2026-04-02, with the clinic note.
The plan declined to accept the request because a claim was already on file.

expected.rationale: One clause allows a request within 14 days of an urgent service, and this one was made in time. Another refuses any request once a claim is on file, and the claim went in first. The policies do not say which prevails, so a person decides.
